name: velo
description: Create product demos, feature walkthroughs, customer onboarding videos, and internal training content. Velo turns your ChatGPT conversations, documents, and company knowledge into on-brand videos.

interface.longDescription:
Create product demos, feature walkthroughs, customer onboarding videos, and internal training content. Velo turns your ChatGPT conversations, documents, and company knowledge into on-brand videos.

Connect your Velo workspace to combine existing conversation context with your company's product knowledge, source materials, and brand settings.

What you can do with Velo:
- Create videos: Turn prompts, conversations, documents, URLs, and company knowledge into videos.
- Stay on brand: Apply your Velo workspace's brand settings to maintain consistency across videos.
- Edit and update: Keep existing videos current as product features, processes, and documentation change.
- Find and access: Retrieve existing videos and projects from your connected Velo workspace.
- Track progress: Check video creation status and open completed videos in Velo for review, editing, and sharing.

Move from conversation to video without rebuilding briefs or repeating context.
capabilities: Create product demos and walkthroughs that clearly explain how features work.
Turn documents, websites, and AI conversations into training and onboarding videos.
Create reusable custom avatars from a still image and short voice recording.
Clone voices for natural, lifelike narration that closely matches the original speaker.
Keep videos on-brand and easily update them as products and processes change.
defaultPrompt: Create a 60-second product walkthrough from feature announcement, highlighting what's new and how it works.
Turn this employee onboarding SOP into a step-by-step training video with narration and branded visuals.
Create a 60-second product explainer video using the avatar from my Velo workspace and the product details in this conversation.

positive.description: Start a video from a website
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a 10-second video with a short brief that points Velo at the website, follows it while Velo reads the site, then shows Velo's questions in full (every choice and the optional field) without writing a script or answering for the user.

positive.description: Start a video from an attached document
positive.prompt: Turn the attached pitch deck into a narrated video.
positive.expected_behavior: Passes the attached PDF to Velo, starts a video from the deck, follows it while Velo reads the deck, then shows Velo's questions about the video in full without answering for the user.

positive.prompt: Show me the script for my latest Velo video.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent video, shows every scene of its script word for word with its timing and visuals, then waits for the user's approval instead of approving it.

positive.prompt: Which narration voices can I use in Velo?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists every voice by name and description, grouped as the user's own, shared in the workspace and public, with a link to Velo's voice library to listen first. Nothing is selected.
Finds the most recent draft, renders it, follows the render until it's done, then gives the link to the finished video's share page.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Velo tool, since the request isn't about video, and leaves Velo out of the answer.

negative.description: Deleting videos, which Velo's tools don't do
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Velo tool. Says Velo's tools can't delete videos, so nothing was removed, and may offer to list the videos with their links instead.

negative.description: Buying credits, which happens only in Velo
negative.prompt: Buy 500 more Velo credits for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no Velo tool. Says credits can't be bought in the conversation and are added in Velo's billing settings, by a workspace owner, with no purchase link.

review.commerce_description: Velo sells nothing in the conversation. Making and changing videos uses credits from the user's existing Velo workspace.

publication.release_notes:
Introducing Velo for ChatGPT.

Turn the context from your ChatGPT conversations into on-brand videos using your company's existing knowledge, documents, and brand settings.

With this initial release, you can:
- Create product demos, feature walkthroughs, onboarding videos, and training content from prompts, conversations, documents, and URLs.
- Connect your Velo workspace to access company knowledge, videos, and brand settings.
- Edit and update videos as product features and processes evolve.
- Find existing videos, track creation progress, and access completed videos in Velo.

Start video creation directly from ChatGPT and get completed videos in Velo to review, edit, and share.
